Body.Content:
What and why

In late October 2026, we began rolling out sales-focused Copilot skills in PowerPoint to help sellers, account teams, and sales leaders prepare customer materials, work with sales data, and refine presentations for sales conversations. Beginning in mid-November 2026, we will introduce additional skills that support tasks such as:

  • Preparing customer-facing presentations, including sales pitches, customer business reviews, client portfolio reviews, and proposal or RFP responses.
  • Working with sales data, including preparing internal sales reviews for leadership, reviewing pipelines and forecasts, and visualizing sales data.
  • Preparing for sales conversations, including creating account briefs, battle cards, and responses to customer objections.
  • Refining existing presentations, including adapting pitches for new audiences and reimagining slides.

These examples illustrate the sales skills experience and are not a complete list. Skill names and availability may change as the experience evolves.

Rollout schedule

  • General Availability (Worldwide): These additional skills will begin rolling out in mid-November 2026, with rollout expected to complete by late November 2026.

Impact on your organization

Who is affected

  • Users with an appropriate Copilot license, including sellers, account teams, and sales leaders.

Platforms and services

  • Microsoft Copilot in PowerPoint for Windows, Mac, and the web
  • Microsoft Copilot Cowork

What will happen

  • Users will be able to use sales-specific skills to create and refine sales presentation drafts in Copilot in PowerPoint.
  • These skills can help sales teams prepare customer and leadership materials more quickly, with content tailored to the audience, opportunity, and next steps.
  • Users can continue creating presentations with Copilot in PowerPoint as they do today.
  • Initially, users can access these skills under the Sales category in Manage Plugins from the Add sources, skills, and more menu in Copilot.
  • When rollout completes, users can enable the Sales plugin from Choose plugins > Discover plugins in the Copilot menu or from Plugins in the left navigation in Copilot Cowork.

Action required and recommendations

No admin action is required for sales skills in PowerPoint. Admins can manage plugins for Copilot Cowork in the Microsoft 365 admin center and Microsoft 365 App Store.

We recommend that you inform sellers, account teams, and sales leaders about the availability of these skills in PowerPoint for Windows, Mac, and web, and that you update internal training materials and documentation as needed.

Learn more

  • Use sales skills in PowerPoint and Cowork | Microsoft Support

Compliance considerations

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
